title: Tokuyama Corporation
content: Tokuyama Corporation is a Japanese chemicals producer supplying sodium silicate and specialty silica materials, including fumed and spherical silica grades. These chemistries are relevant to aerogel precursor, additive, and insulation-material supply chains where silica-based raw materials play a foundational role. Tokuyama is a strong Equipment Materials listing for buyers focused on upstream silica and silicate sourcing.
